name: Shade of Aran
shortDescription: Shade of Aran, represented in the Karazhan research story.
body: The spectral remains of Nielas Aran, Medivh’s father, encountered in Karazhan. The art is an original AI-generated interpretation, not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, formation, or simultaneous presence. The Violet Eye figure ensemble is editorial and does not establish an exact membership list. See the production and visual asset ledgers.
